caption: The drawing depicts a lidded cup with a footed base set on a matching saucer. The cup and saucer are rendered in shades of gray. The cup has a rounded body, a flared rim, and a single curved handle attached to one side. The lid fits securely on top and features a wide golden-brown band near its base. Emerging from the top of the lid are two straight, vertical cylindrical sticks colored brown. In the lower left corner of the image, there is a smaller, outlined version of the same objects, accompanied by measurement notations: the saucer is labeled as 4 1/2 inches across, and the overall height is marked as 4 7/8 inches. The background is an uncolored, plain surface with a neat rectangular border enclosing both the main drawing and the smaller detail inset.
title: Lamp
